name: One Night
source:
You're playing as Fábio and are on your way to get your grandma's inhaler when you notice a stranger. 

Wait...you know them.

But what are they doing out here in the cold? On Christmas  eve? 

Now it's your choice, will you just move on or find out where the night could go.

[From [url=https://momercury.itch.io/one-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演法比奥 (Fábio)，在去拿祖母的吸入器的路上，突然发现了一个陌生人。

等等……你认识他们。

但他们在寒冷的天气里来这里做什么呢？圣诞节前夕？

现在轮到你选择了，你是继续前进还是找出夜晚可以去哪里。

[来自[url=https://momercury.itch.io/one-night]Itch.io[/url]]
